description: Masco Corporation and its subsidiaries is a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of branded home improvement and building products, and its portfolio of industry-leading brands includes BEHR paint, DELTA and HANSGROHE faucets, bath and shower fixtures, LIBERTY branded decorative and functional hardware, and HOT SPRING spas, leveraging its powerful brands across product categories, sales channels and geographies to create value for its customers and shareholders. It believes its solid results of operations and financial position for 2025 resulted from its continued focus on its strategy to drive the full potential of its core businesses, leverage opportunities across its enterprise, and actively manage its portfolio, and in 2025 it continued to return value to its shareholders by repurchasing approximately 8.5 million shares of its common stock and increasing its quarterly dividend by approximately seven percent compared to 2024.
